corrects: The earlier interpretation of the generic --expand-environment hint as the proven cause is withdrawn.

privateEvidenceExtraction.source: already retained local stderr from the sealed single attempt

upstreamFindings.finding: With expansion disabled, the compatibility hint is emitted for any UnknownProperty or PropertyReadOnly error; it does not identify the refused property.
The v255 JobTimeoutUSec branch lacks return r and may fall through to return 0, unlike the adjacent JobRunningTimeoutUSec branch.
JobTimeoutSec measures from job enqueue; JobRunningTimeoutSec excludes queued time. They must not be substituted as equivalent.

evidenceBoundary: A relevant upstream defect matches the observed property identifier, but the installed manager binary and a working compatibility implementation remain unverified.
nextKeyDecision: Authorize local-only compatibility design and regression that preserve the one-second enqueue protection and environment-expansion guard. No new remote attempt or production action is included.
